description: This file contains type guards and utility functions for distinguishing and validating various component types, primitive values, and data structures used in a rendering system. It includes functions to check if a value conforms to specific interfaces such as ResolvedButton, ResolvedImage, ResolvedTabs, etc., and utility functions to identify primitive values like strings, numbers, and booleans, as well as more complex types like component nodes and references.

methods.name: export function isValueMap(value: unknown): value is ValueMap { isValueMap
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is a ValueMap by verifying if it is an object with a 'key' property.

methods.name: export function isPath(key: string, value: unknown): value is string { isPath
methods.description: Checks if a key is 'path' and the associated value is a string.

methods.name: export function isObject(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> { isObject
methods.description: Checks if a value is a non-null object and not an array.

methods.name: export function isComponentArrayReference( isComponentArrayReference
methods.description: Determines if a value is a ComponentArrayReference by checking for properties 'explicitList' or 'template'.

methods.name: function isStringValue(value: unknown): value is StringValue { isStringValue
methods.description: Type guard for StringValue, checking for specific properties indicating string primitives.

methods.name: function isNumberValue(value: unknown): value is NumberValue { isNumberValue
methods.description: Type guard for NumberValue, checking for properties indicating numeric primitives.

methods.name: function isBooleanValue(value: unknown): value is BooleanValue { isBooleanValue
methods.description: Type guard for BooleanValue, checking for properties indicating boolean primitives.

methods.name: function isAnyComponentNode(value: unknown): value is AnyComponentNode { isAnyComponentNode
methods.description: Checks if an object is a generic component node by verifying presence of 'id', 'type', and 'properties'.

methods.name: export function isResolvedAudioPlayer( isResolvedAudioPlayer
methods.description: Type guard to determine if an object is a ResolvedAudioPlayer based on presence of 'url' and a string value.

methods.name: export function isResolvedButton(props: unknown): props is ResolvedButton { isResolvedButton
methods.description: Determines if an object is a ResolvedButton by verifying structure and components.

methods.name: export function isResolvedCard(props: unknown): props is ResolvedCard { isResolvedCard
methods.description: Checks if an object matches the ResolvedCard structure, either via 'child' or 'children'.

methods.name: export function isResolvedCheckbox(props: unknown): props is ResolvedCheckbox { isResolvedCheckbox
methods.description: Type guard for ResolvedCheckbox based on 'label' and 'value' properties.

methods.name: export function isResolvedColumn(props: unknown): props is ResolvedColumn { isResolvedColumn
methods.description: Checks if an object is a ResolvedColumn with a 'children' property array.

methods.name: export function isResolvedDateTimeInput( isResolvedDateTimeInput
methods.description: Type guard for ResolvedDateTimeInput, verifying a 'value' property with StringValue.

methods.name: export function isResolvedDivider(props: unknown): props is ResolvedDivider { isResolvedDivider
methods.description: Checks if the object is a ResolvedDivider, which is any object (dividers can have optional props).

methods.name: export function isResolvedImage(props: unknown): props is ResolvedImage { isResolvedImage
methods.description: Type guard for ResolvedImage based on 'url' property.

methods.name: export function isResolvedIcon(props: unknown): props is ResolvedIcon { isResolvedIcon
methods.description: Type guard for ResolvedIcon based on 'name' property.

methods.name: export function isResolvedList(props: unknown): props is ResolvedList { isResolvedList
methods.description: Checks if an object is a ResolvedList with a 'children' array.

methods.name: export function isResolvedModal(props: unknown): props is ResolvedModal { isResolvedModal
methods.description: Type guard for ResolvedModal based on 'entryPointChild' and 'contentChild' properties.

methods.name: export function isResolvedMultipleChoice( isResolvedMultipleChoice
methods.description: Checks for presence of 'selections' property to identify ResolvedMultipleChoice.

methods.name: export function isResolvedRow(props: unknown): props is ResolvedRow { isResolvedRow
methods.description: Verifies if an object is a ResolvedRow with an array of 'children' components.

methods.name: export function isResolvedSlider(props: unknown): props is ResolvedSlider { isResolvedSlider
methods.description: Type guard for ResolvedSlider based on 'value' as NumberValue.

methods.name: function isResolvedTabItem(item: unknown): item is ResolvedTabItem { isResolvedTabItem
methods.description: Checks if an object is a ResolvedTabItem with 'title' and 'child' properties.

methods.name: export function isResolvedTabs(props: unknown): props is ResolvedTabs { isResolvedTabs
methods.description: Verifies if an object is a ResolvedTabs with 'tabItems' array containing ResolvedTabItems.

methods.name: export function isResolvedText(props: unknown): props is ResolvedText { isResolvedText
methods.description: Type guard for ResolvedText based on 'text' property.

methods.name: export function isResolvedTextField( isResolvedTextField
methods.description: Checks if an object is a ResolvedTextField with a 'label' property.

methods.name: export function isResolvedVideo(props: unknown): props is ResolvedVideo { isResolvedVideo
methods.description: Type guard for ResolvedVideo based on 'url' property.
